title: White Getting Brighter
style: cinematic ambient, 66 BPM, drone pads, breath sounds, near silence, dissolving melody, consciousness fading theme, no percussion, long reverb, space between notes is music, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — drone, barely audible]

[VERSE 1 — barely above whisper]
White getting brighter
Like the sun came through the floor
White getting brighter
I didn't know what it was for

I wasn't going toward it
It was coming toward me
Not a feeling of fear
Just a feeling of free

[CHORUS — drone swells slightly]
White getting brighter
That's what I remember
White getting brighter
Somewhere in that September
The world went quiet
The light went wide
I found the edge of myself
And stepped outside

[VERSE 2]
They say I was under
They say it was close
I say I was somewhere else
Where the light is the host

Not drama — not theatre
Not a story I chose
Just what happened at two
Before anyone knows

[OUTRO — drone fades to silence]
White.
Getting.
Brighter.
